name: Denouement of Sin
description: Legends say that the first Lochknight concealed themselves in the remote wilderness with the Lochfolk, intending to use self-exile and rigorous training in an attempt to repay a sin fated to be beyond redemption. Now the land has long returned to deathly silence, with the long, chill winds still blowing through the deserted valley.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Harmony I
tabs.description:
After the accident at the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering, many masterless constructs went out of control, wandering aimlessly about the caverns around the shore of the lake, waiting for orders that will never come.
If you can destroy the out-of-control clockwork meka, you will obtain the precious artifacts within.
